Name: PineapplePie's Cute Animal Accessories
Author: PineappleMochiPie
Description:
🍍Hi everyone! This is my first mod for Stardew Valley. Please let me know if there are any problems while using it.
🍍Back to the topic! I hope you all enjoy the Cute Animal Accessories I created and have fun with the game. I am thinking of making some more mods, but we will see how that goes( •̀ .̫ •́ )✧

[size=2]🍍[/size][b][size=3]ChangeLogs[/size]
[/b] ﻿1.0.1 - Add in the new Prismatic UnicornHorn!!(showcase in the media section)

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿

[/list]
🍍[size=3][b]How To Use﻿[/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the mod file and all the requested mod[/size]
[*]Unzip the mod file then put it in your mods folder(if you have it please create one first)
[*]Now you can enjoy the content in the game!
[*]Don't forget you need to purchase the Mirror in Pierre's shop, or you can choose to have the Mirror from the beginning while you create a new save(oﾟvﾟ)ノ
[/list][/size]

[/list]
